text: mahato rukkhassa .pe. vibhajatāyasmā ānando agaruṃ karitvāti . #1 ma. yu. nāmasaddo natthi . [175] tenahāvuso 1 suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti . evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ . āyasmā ānando etadavoca yaṃ kho vo 2 āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho tasmā tiha bhikkhave se āyatane veditabbe yattha cakkhu ca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe .pe. yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā
